input: Enroll in a court reporting or stenography taster class

gold.taskTitle: Enroll in a stenography taster class
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and enroll in a short introductory or taster class in court reporting or stenography to explore the field.

questions.title: Do you want an online or in-person class?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants a virtual class they can take remotely or a physical in-person session at a local venue.

questions.title: What country and city are you based in?
questions.description: Identify the user's location to find locally available programs or relevant online providers in their region.

questions.title: What is your current experience with stenography or typing?
questions.description: Gauge the user's skill baseline to ensure the taster class found is pitched at the right level for a true beginner or someone with some prior exposure.

questions.title: Are you leaning toward machine stenography or pen shorthand?
questions.description: Clarify which discipline the user is most interested in, as machine steno and pen shorthand such as Gregg or Pitman are very different paths.

questions.title: What is your budget for this taster class?
questions.description: Understand how much the user is willing to spend so recommendations can be filtered to free, low-cost, or paid options accordingly.

questions.title: When do you want to start this class?
questions.description: Find out the user's desired start timeframe, whether immediately, within weeks, or by a specific date, to prioritize currently open enrollments.

questions.title: Is this purely exploratory or are you considering a career in it?
questions.description: Understand the user's underlying motivation to determine whether to recommend a purely casual taster or one connected to a broader certification or career pathway.
